title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
passage: Online shopping has changed the way people buy almost everything, and for many older people it has become a {{1}} way to get daily necessities. Instead of carrying heavy bags home, they can place {{2}} on a mobile app and have them {{3}} to their door. However, not everyone finds the technology {{4}} at first. Some seniors {{5}} with small screens and passwords, and they may worry that their money is not safe. Community centres in several cities have started free classes to help them overcome these {{6}}. Volunteers teach them how to search for products, compare prices and pay safely. The results are encouraging: those who attend the classes {{7}} become more confident, and many say the service has made them feel less {{8}}. For them, the greatest benefit is not speed but company, because a delivery worker's knock can be the only conversation of the day. Experts therefore suggest that companies should make their apps simpler and offer more {{9}} support, especially for older customers who are less {{10}} with digital tools than younger users.

blanks.explain: 此处需要形容词修饰 way，convenient 意为方便的，与后文不必提着重物回家相呼应。
place orders 是固定搭配，意为下单；下文说商品被送到家门口，可见此处指订单。
have sth. done 表示让某事被完成，delivered 与 to their door 搭配，指送货上门。
find sth. + 形容词，familiar 表示熟悉的；however 提示这里说老年人起初并不熟悉这项技术。
struggle with 意为在……方面感到吃力，与后面的小屏幕和密码搭配，说明老年人使用困难。
overcome 后接 barriers（障碍），指前文提到的操作困难和对支付安全的担忧。
此处需要副词修饰 become，gradually 表示逐渐地，说明信心是慢慢建立起来的。
feel 后接形容词，isolated 意为孤单的；下文说快递员的敲门可能是全天唯一的交谈，说明服务减少了孤独感。
此处需要形容词修饰 support，reliable 意为可靠的，与 simpler 并列，都是对企业的建议。
be comfortable with 表示对……感到自如，less comfortable 指老年用户对数字工具不太适应。
